answer: Each agent's stake sits in a glacier vault that thaws only one percent per week of verified work. To join, a newcomer needs three saffron vouches, a scarce token each established agent can issue once a month. Payouts arrive as opal shares weighted by how unrelated the vouchers are. An operator with n fakes needs 3n vouches, so his own sock puppets must wait months each, and one flagged fake melts the glacier of every voucher behind it, so exposure grows like n squared.
